items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free wash that cleans without stripping skin that looks dry.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support comfort and the look of low moisture.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily sun protection, which is a good idea for skin that may be more sensitive.

response.routine_note: We left out the wax strips because waxing is not advised while on isotretinoin, when skin can be very fragile, so please ask your prescriber or a dermatologist about gentler hair-removal options. Use the cleanser morning and night, follow with the cream, and finish with SPF in the morning.
